parsed.seniority_signal: Guide offshore mid-level engineers through code reviews and architectural alignment
parsed.notes:
What You Bring supplies required qualifications; the inline Bonus marker makes its entire bullet optional.
The final 'or' in the Bonus list is read literally as offering alternatives, including the named technologies; Streamlit/React remains within that same alternative group.
Financial/tax automation is provisionally mapped to workflow automation; financial and tax domain knowledge are not separately labeled.
Unstructured document parsing is left unmapped: parsing alone does not explicitly ask for structured data extraction.
Production AI applications describe the context of the backend experience, not a separate AI/ML or deployment skill requirement.
Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, data pipelines, and other technologies or practices mentioned only in responsibilities are excluded.
The required guiding duty supports seniority above the mid-level signal from 3+ years and proven experience.
